name: Sengoku Ryotaro
source:
A polite and calm young man encountered by Mishiro during her exploration of the Mirror World. Like her, he initially has no recollection of his past life. He often acts as the voice of reason, helping the girls navigate the dangers of the distorted dimensions.

[spoiler]In reality, he is Ryotaro Sengoku, Mishiro's uncle (the brother of her mother, Chika). He tragically died before the events of the game due to a fire at his workplace, and his wandering soul ended up in the Mirror World.[/spoiler]
